1.6.9-stable.notes: works decent for most systems. cant get n64, 32x or genesis (weird I know). Recalbox uses this version (summer 2018) which suggests its performant.

1.7.3-stable.notes: I got the script working with crazyerics and tested with nes. It's SLOW! 32x does seem to start up, but not playable. I can get the menu with f1 and it looks impressive.

1.22.2-stable.notes: Per-system 1.22.2 test path. Emulator files must be supplied under public/emulators/1.22.2-stable. The 1.22.2 extension starts from the 1.6.9-stable CES config and layers these browser/video overrides on top.
